components.name: Bounded container
components.description: A container for a connected diagram or real release metadata.
components.html:
FORGE workspace

Plans, teams and evidence share canonical records.
components.css: .ds-container{padding:30px;background:var(--paper,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#d9dde2);border-radius:14px;color:var(--ink,#20242a)}.ds-container h3{font:600 22px Manrope,sans-serif;margin:0 0 16px}.ds-container p{font:16px/1.7 'IBM Plex Sans Thai',sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#5f6570);margin:0}

narrative.overview: The public website inherits FORGE's orange letterform and bundled typefaces, then gives the product room: broad whitespace, an actual workbench capture and open, readable workflow rows. This is a standalone Persuade/Read surface; its light/dark choice is independent of the product's 15 named editor themes.
keyCharacteristics: Expansive typography paired with practical, readable supporting copy.
Real product proof and explicit development qualifications.
Open rows for content; bounded surfaces for the screenshot and architecture.
One purposeful transition, not repeated section entrances.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Every background, text, line and focus role has an explicit dark counterpart. Change the whole role relationship, not isolated hexes.

rules.name: The Reading Language Rule
rules.body: Thai paragraphs keep generous line height and normal tracking. English display compression never leaks into Thai body text.

dos: Do preserve real product screenshots and their developer-fixture captions.
Do make setup and release limitations readable in both themes and languages.
Do use open rows for explanatory content and full borders for actual containers.
Do keep motion purposeful and remove it for reduced-motion visitors.
donts: Don't invent public releases, completed live checks, users or metrics.
Don't apply the workbench's 15-theme controls to this independent website.
Don't add external fonts, embeds or a dependency on the private local runtime.
